tasks.label: adb reverse 8080
tasks.detail: Lets the phone reach the backend on this Mac at localhost:8080

tasks.label: Build release APK (Wi-Fi)
tasks.detail: Release APK using env.lan.json (backend on this Mac's Wi-Fi IP); copy the APK to the phone and install

tasks.label: Tunnel (cloudflared)
tasks.detail: Public https address for the backend on :8080 (WhatsApp webhook); prints a new trycloudflare.com URL each start

tasks.label: Build release APK (tunnel)
tasks.detail: Standard release APK (no SMS permission) using env.tunnel.json (API_BASE_URL = tunnel https address); works on any network

tasks.label: Build relay APK (tunnel)
tasks.detail: Relay release APK (sends SMS from the SIM) using env.tunnel.json; install it with 'Install relay APK (USB)'

tasks.label: Install relay APK (USB)
tasks.detail: Installs the relay APK on the USB-connected phone; Play Protect blocks installing it from the phone itself
